content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Lemon squeezy

Lemon Squeezy and similar platforms offer a range of features, including payment processing, order management, and product delivery. However, these platforms often rely on Stripe or other restricted payment gateways, making them inaccessible to creators in certain countries. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure provides a base-layer solution, leveraging open-source tools and cryptocurrency payments to create a fully operational online store without relying on restricted platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Lemon Squeezy and other ecommerce platforms typically handle restricted countries by excluding them from their services, citing regulatory or compliance issues. This approach leaves creators in these countries without a viable alternative. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, on the other hand, is designed to bypass these restrictions, providing a permanent structural alternative that empowers creators to take control of their online businesses.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments operates as a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT on multiple chains, Solana, BNB on Binance Smart Chain, and Tron. When a buyer initiates payment, NOWPayments creates a unique payment address for that specific transaction, monitors the blockchain in real time, and fires a webhook when payment confirms on-chain. The 0.5% fee is the only cost — no monthly fee, no setup fee, no revenue share, no payout schedule. Funds go directly to the wallet addresses you configure. COREMERCH never touches your wallet or your funds at any point before, during, or after deployment.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers creators to take control of their online businesses.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Sovereign commerce infrastructure prioritizes ownership, automation, and delivery, providing creators with full control over their online stores and products. With automated payment processing and instant product delivery, creators can focus on developing their businesses, rather than managing complex payment systems. This approach also ensures that creators retain full ownership of their data and customers, eliminating the risks associated with relying on third-party platforms.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The storefront in a COREMERCH deployment is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. It costs nothing to host. It scales to any traffic level automatically. It cannot be taken down by a payment platform's compliance decision because the hosting and the payment layer are completely separate infrastructure. Your buyer experience is clean and professional — a product page, a crypto checkout with QR code generation and live price feeds, and an automatic delivery email within 30 seconds of payment. Every component runs under your own accounts. If COREMERCH closed tomorrow, every store deployed would continue running exactly as it does today. That is what infrastructure ownership means.
